subject: Trading
title: The Terra Luna Crash
description: A 60-second lesson on The Terra Luna Crash.

hook.text: Luna went from $120 to $0.0001 in three days. Its paired stablecoin, UST, broke its dollar peg and died.

buildup.text: UST was an 'algorithmic' stablecoin—it maintained its peg by minting and burning Luna tokens.

discovery.text: When confidence faltered, both tokens entered a death spiral: UST depegged, Luna inflated to worthlessness.

twist.text: Anchor Protocol had promised 20% yield on UST deposits. That unsustainable yield attracted $18 billion.

climax.text: The crash erased $40 billion in days, triggered crypto contagion, and proved algorithmic pegs can fail fatally.

punchline.text: No algorithm could hold when trust let go.

quiz.question: What caused the Terra Luna death spiral?
options: UST lost its dollar peg, triggering mutual collapse with Luna
